## Methods

::: {.workflow-tables}
### PM6-D3 plane-constrained scans, TS and IRC; B3LYP density/ESP

Dispersion-corrected PM6 scans with the molecule held planar locate the in-plane exchange saddle and its IRC, and B3LYP/6-31+G(d) single points give density and ESP along the path.

| Status | Period | Workflow | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ![Caveats](../../../private/research-findings/projects/icons/warning.svg "Caveats: The planar saddle has additional out-of-plane negative curvature, so it is not a full-space first-order TS."){.workflow-status} | 15–20 Oct 2026 | [Plane-constrained carbon exchange](2026-10-15_225959/) | Follows the in-plane exchange from both molecules through the planar saddle, with the ESP along the path. |

### PM6-D3 unconstrained TS searches from displaced guesses

Out-of-plane starting geometries are refined with PM6-D3 and every coordinate free, and frequencies test whether each converged geometry is a first-order saddle.

| Status | Period | Workflow | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ![Caveats](../../../private/research-findings/projects/icons/warning.svg "Caveats: Neither displaced guess reached a converged first-order saddle."){.workflow-status} | 20 Oct 2026 | [Indigo displacement TS experiments](2026-10-20_144850/) | Tests two out-of-plane starting geometries for a first-order saddle; neither converges to one. |

### PM6-D3 dihedral scan and unconstrained TS search

A PM6-D3 scan of the central-bond dihedral supplies a twisted starting geometry for an unconstrained saddle search.

| Status | Period | Workflow | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ![Caveats](../../../private/research-findings/projects/icons/warning.svg "Caveats: The torsional TS search did not converge, and no spin-pure singlet pathway is established."){.workflow-status} | 17 Oct 2026 | Out-of-plane central-bond torsion | Tests whether rotation about the central bond yields a stationary torsional saddle. |
:::
